metcon.name: Part C
metcon.description:
Part C
12 min AMRAP
100m run together
20 Goblet Squats (24/16 kg)
10 Hand-Release Push-ups

hypertrophy.reasoning: Target posterior chain and pulling muscles to balance push-dominant metcon and build work capacity without competing fatigue.
